column8: Clear separate order, line and part-supplier grains with correct measures; snowflaked geography and no dedicated date dimension limit dimensional usability.
Normalized source model with reliable keys and grains but no explicit fact/dimension roles or calendar dimension; minimal redundancy.
Useful order-line fact with derived measures, calendar and customer geography; replicated order descriptors and supplier geography add redundancy without mixing measure grains.
Semantically equivalent to C: clear facts, separate order-total grain, calendar and geographic attributes; physical sort order is not scored.
Customer balance is duplicated across orders in dim_orders, mixing a customer-level measure into the order grain; flattened geography and oversized order dimension add ambiguity.
Sound separate fact grains and calendar, but splitting comments into many 1:1 extension tables complicates the model; descriptive order attributes do not mix measure grains.
Clean, compact star with clear line-level measures and date/geographic hierarchies; however several source attributes and non-line entities are omitted, violating preservation requirement.
Strong dimensional presentation with separate order and part-supplier measures, useful calendar and customer/supplier context; redundant geography and some repeated descriptors remain.
Clear separate fact grains and consistent naming, but no date dimension and duplicate geographic descriptors alongside nation/region tables reduce coherence.
